tradeoffs_and_limits: The serial radiation functions duplicate the parallel arithmetic bodies so Numba assigns distinct persistent cache identities; the AST guard prevents arithmetic drift.
The four installed-wheel radiation cache entries use approximately 528 KiB per tested private cache directory; a full small TIFF run populated approximately 2.1 MiB including other compiled kernels.
Cold first-use includes compilation and showed no stable improvement; only compatible-cache warm execution supports a benefit claim.
OS page cache remains uncontrolled and process-tree RSS sampling has the frozen 20 ms/double-counting caveat.
The independent dense-1024 TMRT discrepancy (0.0495 > 0.01) remains unresolved and is outside this two-file promotion.
